name: Generic webmail sign-in (low-tier, capture + awareness redirect)
description: Deliberately-generic, easy-to-recognise low-tier landing for feed.msoffice365.ch: a plain 'Office 365 Webmail' sign-in with no authentic Microsoft branding (generic mail/cloud glyph, generic German copy). Records email + password + OTP to the tracker (3-step concept — click recorded by the tracker visit, credentials recorded on submit), then redirects to a built-in 'Ooops, du wurdest gephisht' awareness page (learn.html) instead of a real login. Captures are stored in plaintext server-side — use only where the engagement consent covers credential capture, and purge after the programme. Intended as the easiest tier for a trained user to spot as fake.
placeholder_notes: Captures real credentials (DSG/GDPR-sensitive). Branding is intentionally generic/low-effort (no real Microsoft mark) — do NOT upgrade it to a pixel-perfect clone; this tier is meant to be recognisable. learn.html ships with the template — adapt the awareness copy/domain references as needed.
